assertions.text: The hooks.json command uses the full uv -> python3 -> python cascade, not a bare python3/python call or a partial (python3-only-or-python) fallback
assertions.target: outputs/ directory (the hooks.json command string or .sh wrapper produced)

assertions.text: The fallback chain includes a graceful-degradation branch for when none of uv/python3/python is found (no uncaught crash)
Follows the two-file convention: a .sh wrapper (registered by bare path, needs the executable bit) with the actual hook logic in a sibling .py file (never invoked via its own shebang)
The response reads stdin as JSON in the .py logic file (not environment-variable substitution), consistent with hook-development's baseline guidance
